configuration.ephemeris: the default source: jpl-de440 from the sealed pack the package ships, SHA-256 51428874d9a47213abc0ff42cbcec65f338624eaa2d8831f0e6ddc3654bf1fa7, for instants from -76699.5 to 76699.5 days of TT from J2000.0; astronomy-engine 2.1.19 outside them
configuration.timeBasis: from 1972 to 2027-10-02, TT from the leap seconds and UT1 from IERS UT1 − UTC; the ΔT model otherwise
configuration.timeZones: before 1970 the shipped tzdb 2026f history (main+backzone), loaded with prepareLocalTime; from 1970 the host's Intl time zone data (this browser's; its tzdb version is not exposed)
configuration.positions: a plain natalChart with timeScale "tt", outside withEphemeris: the requested instant is read as TT; from the shipped pack, Mars to Pluto are system barycentres, as the vectors are
configuration.angles: natalChart with timeScale "ut1": the requested instant is read as UT1
configuration.host: a browser page: the same handlers as the Node adapter (createHandlers), bundled with esbuild by tools/runtime-conformance/browser-adapter.mjs

runtime.name: chromium
runtime.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/156.0.8078.4 Safari/537.36
